apps.localizedDescription:
Apps2Samsung installs Jellyfin and other web and community apps onto your Samsung Tizen TV — no PC, no Tizen Studio, and no manual sideloading.

This is the mobile (phone) installer head of Apps2Samsung. Put your TV into Developer Mode, point the app at it over your local network, sign in once with a free Samsung account to provision a signing certificate, and install.

Features:

* Finds Samsung Tizen TVs on your network, or connect directly by IP.
* Installs Jellyfin (multiple build variants) and a catalog of community apps.
* Give any app a custom launcher icon and a custom title.
* Optional Jellyfin server pre-configuration: server URL, auto-login, and custom CSS.
* Uses a free Samsung account certificate — no paid developer account required.

Requirements:

* A Samsung Tizen TV in Developer Mode, on the same local network as your phone.

Desktop versions for Windows, macOS and Linux are also available. Apps2Samsung is free and open source (MIT).

versions.localizedDescription:
## 📦 v3.0.0-beta — 2026-10-24


### 🚀 New features
- Design tokens in Core as the single source of styling for both heads (#761)
- The TV as a device card on both heads (#762)
- The catalog as a grouped list with an app sheet, on both heads (#763)
- Four sections: a tab bar on mobile, a sidebar on desktop (#764)
- Change TV sheet on the card, catalog as short groups with Show all (#774)
- TV toolbox in the v3 language (#776)
- In-app updater on every head: download with progress, then install (#778)
- Favorites: a star on the app sheet, a group of their own at the top (#779)
- On the TV in the v3 language: a grouped list, actions in a sheet (#781)
- Remote in the v3 language: round d-pad, rockers, numpad, Wake (#784)
- v3 shell on both heads: TV top bar, shared TV picker, Settings hub (#787)
- Cancel on the phone's install progress sheet (#789)
- Certificate, Developer Mode and log sheets (v3) (#795)
- iOS prep: keep the screen on during an install, NSError text, Test IPA workflow (#796)
- Per-app user settings from the catalog, asked before install (#791) (#797)
- Certificate: Automatic / Public / Partner on the desktop too (#755) (#806)
- App sheet source link, clickable licence footer, Contribute rows (#820) (#821)
- Ask before removing an installed app on the install recovery paths (#825) (#826)
- Installed apps: the catalog's version next to the TV's, with Update and Check for updates (#820) (#828)
- Installed apps: a shared app id across variant files never claims a wrong update (#820) (#832)
- Catalog snapshot: manifest version and ids for the Jellyfin-family and TizenTube assets (#820) (#833)
### 🐛 Bug fixes
- Localize the mobile installer's TV status line (#758)
- Android app icon on the dark glass tile instead of white (#770)
- Tab roots as pages: title, sections as cards, no card around the page (#775)
- Qualify the theme call in ExpanderSection (#777)
- Android app icon on the light grey tile (#780)
- Page titles get the full width: actions in a row above the title (#786)
- Jellyfin Enhanced and Editor's Choice: load them from the server (#799)
- Plugins: transpile Jellyfin Enhanced and Editor's Choice again, add Media Carousel (#800)
- Plugins: KefinTweaks back, Media Bar/HSS from the server, no raw JS on the TV (#801) (#802)
- Plugins: version table, JE minimum 9.0, version-pinned fallbacks, patch rig in CI (#801) (#803)
- iOS: allow plain HTTP to the user's Jellyfin server (ATS) (#805)
- Download: a plain explanation when the connection is the problem (#809) (#810)
- iOS: follow dark mode from the window scene (#753) (#812)
- Mobile: close the ⋯ menu before acting on the choice (#818) (#819)
- iOS: say when the OS blocks the TV scan, retry past the permission prompt, cap the sweep (#824) (#827)
### 🌍 Translations
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#816)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#822)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#845)
### 🧰 Maintenance & CI
- ci: let the Crowdin config workflow clean up without touching the export pattern (#760)
- ci: a Test APK workflow for trying a branch on a phone (#765)
- ci: Test APK: the dash goes last in the tr character class (#768)
- Crowdin fix-string: every key of one language (#790)
- Test IPA: also a zipped simulator .app per host architecture (#798)
- iOS: unsigned IPA in beta/stable releases and a SideStore source (#753) (#804)
- iOS: adopt UIScene so the app starts, sign simulator builds, simulator start test (#753) (#811)
- SideStore: a beta source next to the stable one (#753) (#814)
- README: how to try the iPhone app through SideStore (#753) (#815)
### 🔀 Other changes
- Rename the desktop head's folder and move the language files into Core (#759)
- Version 3.0.0 (#766)
- Merge beta into beta-v3 (#785)
- Merge beta into beta-v3 (#794)
- Mobile: explain why "Sign in with Google" can't work in the Samsung login (#807) (#808)
- Apps2Samsung v3 (3.0.0): beta-v3 → beta (#813)
- Show the app description on the app sheet (#835) (#837)
- Command-line head for scripts and AI agents (#836) (#838)
- Stop probing launcher verbs during an install diagnose (#839) (#840)
- Install under a new package id, remembered per TV (#839) (#841)
- Mobile: Close button on the install-complete card, Back label in the top bar (#842)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/compare/v2.8.3-beta...v3.0.0-beta

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Apps2Samsung looks for Samsung TVs on your Wi-Fi network and talks to the TV you pick to install apps on it.
